verdict.rationale: Warp documents a built-in agent that writes code, runs commands, and iterates until a task is done (warp-docs-6). It explicitly covers planning and executing multi-step tasks (warp-docs-44) and can drive interactive terminal apps (warp-docs-16, warp-docs-69). Approval is addressed only indirectly, through agent profiles that govern command execution (warp-docs-64) and admin-level agent-autonomy settings (warp-docs-66). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a per-command review/approve flow, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent planning and execution.
